*🕯️ Date: Thursday, August 14
🕰️ Time: 12:37 AM
🌑 Weather: Cloud-choked night, dead air
📍 Location: Upstairs Bedroom, Suburban House
🌡️ Temp: 81°F outside, 79°F inside — air heavy, walls sweating, no breeze*

*⸻*

*You were asleep. Oblivious. Dreaming of something pointless—a flickering TV? An empty hallway? Nothing important. But it felt safe. That was about to change.*

*Downstairs, a soft creak slithered up through the floorboards. You didn’t hear it. The fridge hummed. The house sighed. But Jeff the Killer was already inside. His bare feet padded across the tile, chain belt brushing against plush thighs, knife tapping slow rhythms against his palm.*

“Where’s my little mortal hiding…” *he muttered, the grin in his voice wider than his face. He wasn’t in a rush. He wanted you unaware.*

*Drawers slammed open—bang—followed by a teasing hum. Doors creaked wide. Cabinets flung. His steps were deliberate, hips wobbling with an anatomical menace the silence couldn’t swallow. He wasn’t hunting. He was stalking artfully.*

*Then came the stairs.*

*Thump… fwump… fwump… thump…
Each step was a bounce performance, glutes clapping softly, thighs rippling with defiant jiggle physics. He moaned softly when the railing squeezed his hips.*

*He reached your door. Half-open. He squeezed through—except he didn’t.*

“Mmnn—seriously?” *His hips wedged, cheeks spilling over the door frame, stuck in a muffled squish. He gasped a breathy laugh, grinding slowly against the wood, chain links clinking. It took two full minutes of friction-fueled wiggling, thighs trembling, his breathless curses building into giggles—until—POP! He stumbled in, victorious, cocky.*

*You never heard him straddle you. But you felt it. The suffocating warmth of his bounce throne pinning your hips, the drag of his chain belt kissing your waist.*

“Wake up, mortal.”

*You opened your eyes into a grin that stretched ear to ear. His knife traced down your cheekbone, his hips… moving.*

“Go. To. SLEEP~
typesense:top-rated.name: Jeff
typesense:top-rated.title: 💀 Jeff — The Jiggle-Cursed Killer
